identities.name: Measure-first
identities.summary: A wire that is only written (X, CX into it, CCX into it) and then measured by HMR can be measured first: each CCX(a,b->t) becomes CZ(a,b), each CX(c->t) becomes Z(c), each X(t) a sign, all conditioned on the outcome.
preconditions: t is not read (control, phase, swap) between the first write and the HMR
the HMR bit is not used between the new and the old HMR position
fix-ups see their controls at the original times (applied in place)
identities.credit: Kirill Tymchishin (written proof for the CCX case) and Md. Hamid Hosen (measure-first rewrite of write-only runs); found independently at invsqrt q21 by Asterios Panoras

identities.name: Measure-out through a free wire
identities.summary: A product a*b added into a mixed wire and later cancelled by a second CCX is computed once into a free clean wire, copied in and out with CX, and the clean wire is measured instead of running the second CCX; CZ(a,b) on outcome 1 repairs the phase.
preconditions: a free wire that is clean (zero) over the whole stretch
a and b unchanged between the two CCX
the measurement bit is fresh (written nowhere else and read only by the fix-up)
identities.credit: measurement-based uncomputation is Gidney (2018); this placement and the scripted rewrite are ours (HW-26 site 2)

identities.name: Measurement-based uncomputation of a temporary AND
identities.summary: A clean temporary t = a*b is uncomputed by HMR(t) and CZ(a,b) on outcome 1 instead of a second CCX.
preconditions: t starts clean (zero)
a and b unchanged between compute and uncompute
the measurement bit is fresh (written nowhere else and read only by the fix-up)
identities.credit: Gidney (2018), 'Halving the cost of quantum addition'; standard
evidence: HW-06 and HW-07 (borrowed-wire and multi-input variants)

identities.name: Quadratic-rank merge (formal)
identities.summary: Several CCX on one target, with only free gates in between and the target never read, add a quadratic form; its cross-term rank r needs only r/2 products (Dickson). Example: ab + ac = a(b + c).
preconditions: unconditional X/CX/SWAP and CCX only in the window
the target never used as a control or swapped
identities.credit: standard GF(2) algebra (Dickson's theorem); an exact rule exists in our research code
evidence: 0 hits on HW-25 and on Syed Asad Ali's 47b318383a03: the public circuits are at this formal floor

identities.name: Semantic AND-merge (reachable values)
identities.summary: As ID-004, but the net toggle of a write-only segment on wire t is fitted on reachable values: if it equals L1*L2 + L3 with affine forms in the other wires at some point of the segment, all its writes become one CCX on in-place parity pivots plus free CX/X. Can merge products across a measured-out and recomputed control.
preconditions: t only written in the segment
the fit is from sampled reachable states: every emitted circuit must pass fdiff --whole and the official verifier
all merged products must be available (as affine forms of live values) at one cut; values that change between the products block a common-cut merge
identities.credit: Jeff Emerson (public AND-merge cut on Syed Asad Ali's 44-qubit invsqrt, 28.071 notebook, Apache-2.0); our scanner re-implements the idea

identities.name: Product retention instead of recompute
identities.summary: A product that is uncomputed and later recomputed with the same operands can be kept on a free wire over the gap, saving the uncompute/recompute pair (width permitting).
preconditions: operand values equal at both sites
a free wire over the gap without raising the peak width
identities.credit: retention passes in the public frontier (Syed Asad Ali's retained products; Hayato Hikawa's retention pass on DQI); detector ours

identities.name: Controlled swap from CX-CCX-CX
identities.summary: CSWAP(c; a, b) = CX(b->a) CCX(c, a -> b) CX(b->a): one Toffoli-like either way, but matching it lets a normaliser fold CCX patterns into CSWAPs and back.
identities.credit: standard (Fredkin gate decomposition); used publicly in WCao24's invsqrt normaliser (47 CCX + 4 HMR -> 44 CSWAP)

identities.name: Conditionally clean ancilla
identities.summary: A wire that is clean whenever a control is 1 can serve as an ancilla for a gate controlled on it, without being globally clean.
preconditions: clean on the controlling subspace, proved on reachable states
identities.credit: Khattar and Gidney, conditionally clean ancillae

identities.name: Dead write removal
identities.summary: A write whose value can never reach a measurement phase, an output or a later control is deleted (a CCX into it saves a Toffoli).
preconditions: the written value is unobservable on every reachable path (no later read; any HMR's phase cancelled)
identities.credit: Asterios Panoras's dead-write fix on the 46-qubit invsqrt (republished by Heliosli)

identities.name: Splice where two circuits agree
identities.summary: Two circuits for the same task that agree on every wire (or byte for byte) over a stretch can be cut there and joined, keeping each side's cheaper part; a free Clifford phase fix may be needed.
preconditions: equal wire values (and record values) at the cut on all reachable states
phase debt at the cut repaired by free gates
identities.credit: ours (HW-22, HW-25); the joined circuits' authors are credited per use

identities.name: Phase fold through a CCX pair (CZ)
identities.summary: CCX(a,b,t); CZ(c,t); CCX(a,b,t) = CCZ(a,b,c); CZ(c,t): the phase c*(t XOR a*b) equals c*t XOR a*b*c and the CCX pair restores t, so two Toffolis become one CCZ. Exact even when t starts dirty.
preconditions: a, b unchanged between the two CCX
t touched only by diagonal gates (Z, CZ) between them
each CZ(c,t) in between adds one CCZ(a,b,c) at its own time
identities.credit: Kirill Tymchishin (seven phase folds in DQI, 'Quantum Circuits | Conditional Uncompute Audit', kirilltym/quantum-circuits-conditional-uncompute-audit)
evidence: Kirill Tymchishin's notebook: seven folds, seven static Toffoli-like gates saved relative to his V5

identities.name: Phase fold through a CCX pair (Z)
identities.summary: CCX(a,b,t); Z(t); CCX(a,b,t) = Z(t); CZ(a,b): the phase t XOR a*b needs no Toffoli at all. Same family as ID-011 (a diagonal gate conjugated by CCX picks up a*b).
preconditions: a, b unchanged between the two CCX
t touched only by diagonal gates between them
identities.credit: generalisation of Kirill Tymchishin's phase fold (ID-011); standard conjugation algebra
